content.short: Forest Knight is a decentralized turn-based strategy mobile game.
content.description: Forest Knight is a turn-based strategy mobile game that features a decentralized item ecosystem powered by digital collectibles and KNIGHT. It is free-to-play and gives players true digital ownership of in-game assets, enabling them to engage with the game's evolving ecosystem while enjoying a strategic and entertaining experience. The title emphasizes tactical decision-making and the collection of unique items, inviting players to build, compete, and enjoy the game’s dynamic challenges.
content.meta: Forest Knight is a turn-based strategy game with a decentralized item ecosystem. Discover Forest Knight and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
